name: Proxmox VE
description: Proxmox VE is an open-source server virtualization platform combining KVM hypervisor and LXC containers with a unified web-based management interface. Built by Proxmox Server Solutions GmbH in Vienna, it enables management of VMs, containers, storage, and networking across bare-metal clusters without vendor lock-in.

owner.name: Proxmox Server Solutions GmbH
owner.description: Austrian company based in Vienna developing open-source virtualization software.
